beats.description: Teams this one converts on a hit (rock beats scissors).

teams.description: Teams for territory, conversion and team battles.

mode.description: follow: gently keep the action centered. zoomOut: frame the innermost ring the ball is still inside (for dozens of nested rings). chase: lock onto the lead ball up close (use zoom 2–4), so only the rings around it are in view (for hundreds or thousands of rings).

orient.description: chase: turn the view so the way out (away from the rings’ center) points down (the ball falls through floor after floor) or up (it climbs).

aperture.description: Clip the playfield to a circular window of this radius in screen pixels, keeping text clear during zooms.

shake.description: Screen shake on breaks, knockouts and escapes, and on streaks of escapes (0 = off).

slowmo.description: Seconds of slow motion starting just before the climax (0 = off).

slowmoLead.description: Seconds of the run before the climax that are already slowed.

countdown.description: A 3-2-1-GO intro: this many counts with the run frozen.

endOn.description: oneTeam = every ball left is on one team; finish = a ball reaches a finish zone; cleared = every brick and breakable ring is gone; mostTerritory = lock the board at max minus tail and show who owns the most cells.

tail.description: Seconds to keep rolling after the ending event.

trimStart.description: Export skips this many seconds (the simulation still runs from 0). Perfect loops use it.

seconds.description: Countdown length. The run must reach its ending before zero, or it ends there with "Time’s up". Sets duration.max to seconds + tail.

final.description: The final stretch (seconds before zero): the clock turns red, pulses and ticks, and rush actions fire.

x.description: Spawn point. In a rule, defaults to the container the event happened at.

perSpeed.description: Extra damage per 1000 px/s of impact.

when.description: On a hit: "defending" damages only the ball that was struck (the one coming in slower), so two equal balls never trade damage.

min.description: Balls smaller than this stop splitting.

angle.description: Degrees between the two halves’ directions.

recolor.description: The new half takes the next palette color.

anyOf.description: The ball splits into two, each with half the area.
On a hit: the bigger ball swallows the smaller and gains its area.
On a hit: two balls of the same level fuse into one of the next level.

mode.description: beats: only if this ball’s team beats the other’s (teams[].beats). always: the hit ball always switches.

chance.description: Probability a hit converts (lower = slower spread).

anyOf.description: On a hit: the other ball joins this ball’s team.
Leave a frozen, immovable copy of the ball where it is.
Every gap of the ring jumps to a new random angle.
Open another gap at a random angle.
A polygon gains a side.
The ball takes the next palette color.

swallow.description: px added to the swallow radius.

anyOf.description: Every force field gets stronger (a black hole that grows).
End the run now (the climax); the tail plays on.
Lock every ball where it is (a settled pile holds its picture).

rush.description: Actions fired every rushEvery seconds through the final stretch (e.g. shrinkGap with a negative amount widens the exit; speedUp for battles), so the climax tends to land right before zero.

ticks.description: A tick each second of the final stretch and a buzzer at zero.

timeUpText.description: Banner when the clock hits zero first.

clock.description: A countdown: urgency on screen, an escalating final stretch, and a hard stop at zero.

gravity.description: px/s². A number pulls down; [x, y] is a vector.

keepEnergy.description: Hold each ball’s energy constant so bounces never die out.

friction.description: Share of sliding speed lost on each wall/peg contact. 0 = frictionless.

damping.description: Velocity lost per second (air drag). Helps piles settle; 0 = none.

speedScale.description: Multiplies every ball launch speed. The Director tunes this.

spinScale.description: Multiplies every container spin. The Director tunes this.

on.description: bounce = ball hits a wall; hit = two balls collide; eliminate = a ball runs out of hp; strike = a weapon hits a ball; wake = a frozen ball is woken; break = a ball breaks a brick, ring segment or ring; teleport = through a portal; swallow = eaten by a black hole, drain or bigger ball; capture = repaints a territory cell; merge = two balls fused; convert = a ball switched team; corner = a polygon bounce right in a corner; finish = a ball crossed a finish zone.

do.description: Ball actions (grow, speedUp, damage) apply to every live ball.

script.description: JavaScript run each time this fires, with `ctx` (ctx.ball is null).

paint.description: Balls leave permanent paint on the background.

renderer.description: Ball drawing: webgl handles thousands of balls; auto picks it for crowd scenes.

backgroundImage.description: A picture from images/ filling the background (cropped to fit).

backgroundDim.description: How much to darken the background picture so balls stand out.

theme.description: A look: fills in colors and styles you haven’t set.

colorMode.description: bounce: new color every bounce; rainbow: hue drifts; speed: blue when slow, white-hot when fast.

lines.description: String art: center = each bounce point to the ring center; web = to the previous bounce point; star = to the bounce 5 back; tether = a live line from ball to center.

glitch.description: Digital glitch: the frame tears into shifted slices with split colors on big moments (streaks of escapes, breaks, knockouts).

mirror.description: Mirror the playfield: x = left half reflected onto the right, y = top onto bottom, quad = a four-way kaleidoscope. Drawing only; text stays readable.

at.description: Sample landing spots at this time (default: the end).

reveal.description: Picture reveal: each ball is colored by where it will land, so the run ends in this word or picture.

revealColors.description: Filled in by the studio for a reveal: color per ball id.

notes.description: Inline melody as MIDI note numbers; an array is a chord. Overrides melody.

chords.description: With a MIDI melody: play every note struck together, not just the top one.

parts.description: With a MIDI melody: which parts (track/channel pairs, numbered from 0) play on bounces. Default: the detected melody part.

noteTimes.description: Filled in by the studio from the MIDI file: when each melody note falls in the song (seconds). Used for rhythm sync.

backing.description: With rhythm lock: play the rest of the song (the parts not on bounces) in time underneath.

backingParts.description: Which parts play as backing. Default: every part not on bounces.

backingNotes.description: Filled in by the studio: [time, note] of every backing note.

rhythmLock.description: Keep bounces in time with the MIDI song: after each bounce the ball’s speed is set so it reaches the wall exactly on the next note. Needs zero gravity, one ball and a ring.

tempo.description: With rhythmLock: song speed multiplier. Default: chosen so the ball keeps roughly its launch speed.

climax.description: A big sound at the climax.

pitchBy.description: size: bigger balls play lower; height: higher on screen plays higher; speed: faster plays higher.

eventSounds.description: Sounds for breaks, portals, merges, captures and swallows.

bounceSpacing.description: Minimum seconds between audible bounce notes. Useful for dense pours.

escapeStyle.description: The escape sound. classic: thump, whoosh and chord (spaced out). voice / glitch / static / tape: one short clip that restarts on every escape, cutting itself off, so a streak of escapes stutters (a-a-a-a-ah).

burst.description: A sound on a streak of escapes (burstAt or more within 0.4 s): dive = a falling, endless-seeming swoop and sub; drop = a bass drop; choir = a dissonant choir swell.

burstAt.description: Escapes within 0.4 s that count as a streak (burst sound, shake, glitch, streak counter).

drone.description: A bed under everything. shepard: a tone that seems to fall forever; hum: mains hum and tape hiss (analog horror); choir: a low, slowly shifting vowel cluster. It swells as the clock runs down.

reverb.description: Room: 0 = dry, 1 = a huge, washed-out hall (slowed + reverb, dreamcore).

hitSound.description: Click when balls hit each other.

titleY.description: Where the title sits (px from the top of the 1920 frame).

counterY.description: Where the counter and timer sit. Default: near the bottom.

labelSize.description: Size of the names under balls.

timer.description: Elapsed time on the counter line (scenes without a clock).

clock.description: Show the clock’s countdown (big digits and a draining bar under the title). Needs a scene clock.

clockY.description: Where the countdown digits sit. Default: just under the title.

counter.description: ringsLeft: rings the lead ball still has to escape, counting down.

streak.description: Pop a running count (−47) next to the ball while it escapes ring after ring in one go.

vhs.description: A camcorder stamp: PLAY ▶ and a running tape timestamp in the corners (analog horror).

endCard.description: Text shown over the tail after the climax ("Follow for part 2").

reveal.description: A message revealed one word (or letter) per bounce.

progress.description: Time left, as a bar under the title or a ring around the counter.

teamBar.description: Show each team’s share as a bar (team formats).

resultPosition.description: Place the result in the title area to keep the final play visible.

winner.description: Show a winner banner when a race or battle ends.

extends.description: Inherit from another scene (file name without .json).

modifiers.description:
grow-on-bounce: The ball grows a little with every wall bounce. Ends when it fills its ring.
shrinking-gap: The exit gets narrower with every bounce.
speed-up: Every bounce makes the ball a little faster.
spin-up: Every bounce spins the container faster.
multiply: Every escape spawns new balls back inside. Runs to the time limit.
zero-g: No gravity: balls fly in straight lines.
gravity-flip: Gravity reverses on a timer.
gravity-spin: Gravity rotates a quarter turn on a timer.
paint: Balls leave permanent paint instead of fading trails.
battle: Balls lose hp when they collide; the last one standing wins.
race: First ball out wins.
break-rings: Rings are cut into segments that break when hit: the ball smashes its way out.
hp-ring: Each ring has hit points and shatters when they run out.
split: Every bounce splits the ball in two (until they get tiny).
absorb: Bigger eats smaller: on contact the bigger ball swallows the smaller one. Last one wins.
merge: Two balls of the same level merge into a bigger one.
infection: One zombie, everyone else human: a zombie hit turns a human. Ends when everyone has turned.
rps: Rock, paper, scissors: every hit converts the loser. Ends when one side owns the arena.
black-hole: A black hole in the middle pulls everything in and swallows what gets too close.
storm: The arena shrinks steadily (battle royale storm).
add-side: Every bounce adds a side to the polygon: triangle to circle.
gap-jump: The exit jumps to a new random spot on every bounce.
clone-trail: Every bounce leaves a frozen clone behind; the ring slowly jams up.
butterfly: Butterfly effect: ghost copies of each ball launched a millionth of a degree apart. They never touch, and slowly drift apart.
string-art: Every bounce draws a line to the last bounce point: string art.
slowmo: Slow motion around the climax.
meow: Every bounce meows (in tune).
rainbow: Colors drift through the rainbow, with rainbow trails.
shake: Screen shake on breaks, escapes and knockouts.
portals: A pair of linked portals inside the arena.
clock: A countdown: beat it or "Time’s up". The final stretch turns red, ticks, and escalates (the exit widens, or balls speed up) so the climax tends to land just before zero.
vhs: Analog horror: a camcorder tape at 3 a.m. Scanlines, grain, color fringing, glitch tears on big moments, a PLAY ▶ stamp and a mains-hum drone.
dreamcore: Slowed + reverb: everything a few semitones down in a huge, washed-out hall, soft bloom, long hazy trails and pastel colors.
stutter: Every escape restarts one short clip of a voice, cutting itself off, so a run of escapes stutters (a-a-a-a-ah); a streak of them drops into an endless falling swoop.
shepard: A Shepard tone under everything: a pitch that seems to fall forever and never lands, swelling as the clock runs down.
glitch: Digital glitch: the frame tears into shifted, color-split slices on every big moment, with a bass drop on streaks.
mirror: The playfield is mirrored: the left half reflected onto the right (or a four-way kaleidoscope). Text stays readable.
eyes: Every ball becomes an eye.
whisper: An out-of-place sentence appears one word per bounce (weirdcore text).
breathe: The walls breathe: every ring and polygon slowly swells and shrinks.
backrooms: The backrooms: damp yellow wallpaper, buzzing fluorescent hum, a camcorder grain.
tunnel-vision: The camera locks onto the ball up close, so you never see the whole arena.
descent: The ring falls away: gravity points outward from the center (balls fall out through the walls) and the camera follows the ball down.
countdown: A 3-2-1-GO intro with the run frozen.

spin.description: Rotation speed in radians per second. Positive = clockwise.

at.description: Center of the gap in degrees (0 = right, 90 = down), relative to the ring rotation.

width.description: Angular width of the gap in degrees.

gaps.description: Openings in the ring. [] = closed ring.

repeat.description: The gaps repeat this many times, evenly, around the ring (so a huge ring can have hundreds of gaps). Give gap angles within the first 360/repeat degrees.

hp.description: Breakable: the ring shatters after this many bounces (every ball inside escapes).

segments.description: Cut the ring into this many segments that break one by one (each after segmentHp bounces).

segmentHp.description: With segments: bounces each segment takes before it breaks.

deadly.description: Touching the ring eliminates the ball.

oneWay.description: Once a ball is out it stays out: from outside, the gaps are solid (no falling back in).

anyOf.description: A circular wall the balls start inside. Escaping = leaving through a gap.

radius.description: Distance from center to each corner.

open.description: Indices of sides with an exit. [] = closed.

gap.description: Width (px) of the exit in each open side, centered. Default: the whole side is missing.

hp.description: Breakable: the polygon shatters after this many bounces.

deadly.description: Touching a side eliminates the ball.

anyOf.description: A spinning regular polygon the balls start inside. Missing sides are exits.

deadly.description: Touching it eliminates the ball (spikes, lava).

boost.description: Bumper: ball speed is multiplied by this on each bounce (1 = normal).

hp.description: Breakable: disappears after this many bounces.

anyOf.description: A static straight wall (two-sided).

boost.description: Bumper: ball speed is multiplied by this on each bounce (pinball bumpers use ~1.3).

hp.description: Breakable: disappears after this many bounces.

anyOf.description: A static round peg.

kill.description: A drain: balls entering it are removed.

finish.description: A finish line: the first ball in wins (use with endOn: finish).

anyOf.description: An invisible region that counts each ball entering it (once per ball).

x.description: Spawn position. Defaults to the first container center.

direction.description: Launch direction in degrees. Random (from the seed) when omitted.

count.description: How many to spawn. 0 = template only (for spawn actions).

spread.description: Random position jitter in px. Defaults to 40 when count > 1.

labels.description: Per-ball names (teams, countries), cycled. Shown under each ball.

image.description: A picture from images/ (file name, e.g. "cat.png") cropped into the ball.

emoji.description: An emoji drawn on the ball (e.g. "🍕"; flags like "🇧🇷" work on Mac).

hp.description: Hit points. Balls without hp cannot be damaged.

frozen.description: Starts still and weightless; wakes up when another ball hits it (chain reactions).

arrange.description: With count > 1: scatter randomly within spread, or lay out in a tidy grid that never overlaps.

shape.description: How the ball is drawn (it spins as it moves). Collisions still use its circle.

team.description: Team name (from the scene’s teams). Sets the color and emoji unless given.

level.description: Merge level (balls of the same level merge into the next one).

copies.description: Butterfly effect: spawn this many ghost copies of each ball that never touch each other.

jitter.description: With copies: degrees added to the launch direction of each copy.

kind.description: blade: plain. sword: +damage per hit. dagger: spins faster per hit. spear: longer per hit. hammer: huge knockback. scythe: long and fast. bow: fires arrows (more per hit). unarmed: no blade, body hits do damage and it speeds up per hit.

grow.description: How the weapon powers up with each hit it lands. Default: set by kind.

knockback.description: Multiplier on the push a strike gives.

spin.description: rad/s. Weapons that clash reverse direction.

damage.description: hp taken from a ball the weapon strikes.

weapon.description: A spinning blade attached to the ball: strikes damage and knock back other balls.

hp.description: Bounces it takes before breaking. Shown on the brick.

anyOf.description: A breakable rectangle with a hit counter (brick breaker).

pivot.description: Turn about the bar’s middle (a propeller) or one end (a paddle / sweeper).

deadly.description: A blade: touching it eliminates the ball.

anyOf.description: A rotating bar: paddles, propellers, sweepers, saw blades.
Two linked holes: a ball entering one comes out of the other at the same speed and direction.

strength.description: attract/repel/vortex: acceleration (px/s²) at 100 px away, falling with distance. wind: acceleration everywhere. radial: the same push away from (x, y) at every distance, like gravity pointing outward (negative pulls inward).

radius.description: Only acts within this distance (0 = everywhere).

swallow.description: attract: balls closer than this are swallowed (a black hole). 0 = none.

inward.description: vortex: how much of the pull is inward (0 = pure swirl, 1 = mostly inward).

anyOf.description: A force field: a black hole / sun (attract), repeller, whirlpool (vortex), wind, or radial (gravity that points away from a center: balls "fall" outward through rings).

cone.description: Random spread of the direction, degrees.

jitter.description: Random spread of the position, px.

radiusJitter.description: Random ± px on each ball’s radius.

colors.description: Cycled per ball. Default: the palette.

rainbow.description: Color balls along a smooth rainbow as they come out.

level.description: Merge level of each ball (random 0..level when levels is on).

levels.description: Each ball gets a random merge level from 0 to level.

loop.description: Keep emitting forever, replacing balls removed by drains (count = how many at once).

anyOf.description: A spawner: pours balls over time (sand, droppers, refills).

layout.description: Initial ownership. Paint starts blank and awards cells under a moving ball to its team without reflecting it.

anyOf.description: A tiled board for territory battles: a team ball passes through its own color, bounces off other colors and repaints them.

angles.description: Starting angles in degrees from straight down.

spread.description: Degrees added to the last arm’s angle for each copy (chaos: 0.001).

wave.description: Pendulum wave: > 0 = copies hang side by side with lengths tuned so the pattern repeats every this many seconds.

waveBase.description: Pendulum wave: swings of the longest pendulum per pattern.

colors.description: Per copy, cycled. Default: a rainbow.

chime.description: Play a note when a bob swings through the bottom.

anyOf.description: Pendulums: chaos (double pendulums a hair apart) or a pendulum wave. Drawn with trails; they don’t collide with balls.

spinFalloff.description: Each ring outward spins this fraction of the previous.

alternate.description: Alternate spin direction ring to ring.

gapWidth.description: Gap of the innermost ring in degrees.

gapShrink.description: Each ring outward has a gap this many degrees narrower.

colors.description: Ring colors, inner to outer, cycled.

spacing.description: Fixed px between rings (ignores outer): for dozens or hundreds of rings, with camera.mode zoomOut.

rainbow.description: Color the rings along a rainbow, inner to outer.

segments.description: Breakable: cut every ring into this many segments.

segmentHpGrow.description: Extra segment hp per ring outward.

hp.description: Breakable: each ring shatters after this many bounces.

hpGrow.description: Extra ring hp per ring outward.

anyOf.description: Prefab: concentric rings with staggered gaps.

spacing.description: px between rings. Leave room for the ball: spacing − thickness > its diameter.

gapArc.description: Width of every gap in px along the ring (the same on every ring, so a lined-up stack of gaps is a straight shaft).

gapEvery.description: px of ring between neighbouring gaps (big rings get more gaps).

layerMin.description: Rings per stratum near the center.

layerMax.description: Rings per stratum at the outside.

layerCurve.description: How late the strata thicken (1 = steadily, 2+ = the deep drops come at the end).

drift.description: px of random misalignment between the gaps of neighbouring rings in a stratum (0 = a perfectly straight shaft).

speed.description: px/s each stratum turns at its own radius (each stratum is one rigid piece, so its shafts stay lined up).

fall.description: Lean the shafts for a ball falling outward with this gravity (px/s², a radial force’s strength): each hole is set back by how far its ring turns while the ball falls to it, so a ball dropping from rest stays in the shaft. 0 = straight shafts.

fallDrag.description: With fall: the world damping, so the lean matches the ball’s real fall.

speedJitter.description: Random ± share of speed per stratum.

colors.description: Colors per stratum, cycled. Default: the ring color.

fadeTo.description: A #rrggbb color the rings shade toward with depth (with #rrggbb colors).

oneWay.description: Rings close behind the ball: no falling back up a shaft.

seed.description: Layout seed (where the strata break and their shafts sit). Separate from the scene seed.

anyOf.description: Prefab: hundreds or thousands of rings in strata. Inside a stratum the gaps line up into shafts, so a ball that finds one drops through the whole stratum at once; the strata get thicker toward the outside.

stagger.description: Offset every other row by half a spacing.

anyOf.description: Prefab: a grid of pegs (Plinko / Galton board).

walls.description: Add side walls that run up to the board.

anyOf.description: Prefab: a row of bins with a floor, dividers, and a counting zone in each.

hpGrow.description: Extra hp per row toward the top.

colors.description: Row colors, cycled. Default: the palette.

anyOf.description: Prefab: a grid of numbered, breakable bricks.
Prefab: two angled walls that funnel balls to a gap.

levels.description: Zig-zag ramps from top to bottom.

opening.description: Gap at the low end of each ramp.

anyOf.description: Prefab: a marble-race run of zig-zag ramps, spinners and bumpers between two side walls.
